a1_subject: Parameterized classes and interfaces (when expanded)
a1_text: Parameterized classes and interfaces (when expanded). This item is required. This item need not be documented in the implementor's user documentation. (Clause 7, Compiler directing facility)

staged_record.notes: Rule: A.1 item 138 'Parameterized classes and interfaces (when expanded). This item is required. This item need not be documented in the implementor's user documentation. (Clause 7, Compiler directing facility)' (cite.py --check A.1 -> OK §A.1 138)). The operative text is §7.1: 'The manner and time of expansion of parameterized classes and parameterized interfaces is defined by the implementor, except that it occurs after the text manipulation stage of processing.' (cite.py --check 7.1 -> OK §7.1). No documentation obligation, so part (a) is waived (no '| DOC-A.1-138 |' row; the manner is written voluntarily in OoExpansion's header and the OO deep-dive D12, kb/Work PB759). Part (b), the only hard constraint - expansion AFTER text manipulation: OoExpansion.Expand is called from BinderDriver (line ~332) on the parse tree of the already-preprocessed source (COPY/REPLACE/directives are finished before parsing), and each expansion re-parses the parameterized definition's own post-manipulation tokens with every formal replaced by its actual (§12.3.8.4 GR5) and the header renamed - so the time is 'at bind time of the compilation group, after text manipulation', and the manner is token substitution into an ordinary class (never a CLR generic). Identity per §9.3.12 (one class per (definition, actuals) triple; COBOLNET2240 on a conflicting reuse). Pinned: conformance:2002/pb759_parameterized_class (a class USING ELEM expanded over two actuals, INHERITS-by-formal, an interface expanded in two source elements under one name, an expansion of an expansion; separate factory counters COUNT 1/2/1/1). Caveat for the refuter: the golden pins the MANNER (substitution semantics) and not a text-manipulation interaction directly; the after-text-manipulation ordering is verified structurally (parse precedes bind), not by a REPLACE-over-a-formal probe. Editions: parameterized classes are OO, 2002+. Owning note: kb/Work PB759 (landed). No open note. || Owning note: kb/Work/PB1535.
